stronger_left_out.name: Mount Warning
stronger_left_out.reason: Near-duplicate of Wollumbin National Park (the summit track is closed and the park spot already centres on the mountain); keep one entry, carry the alias in search.

stronger_left_out.name: Casino
stronger_left_out.reason: Service town; Wikivoyage names it only as beef capital, nothing for a visitor to do for half an hour.

stronger_left_out.name: Kyogle
stronger_left_out.reason: Downgraded from keep: a gateway town whose draw is the parks beyond it (Border Ranges, Toonumbar), the Pipiriki pattern in COVERAGE.md. For: Wikivoyage calls it the gateway and it is the rail/road stop. Against: one source, no sight of its own.

stronger_left_out.name: New Italy
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: Wikivoyage lists the Italian-settler heritage village with a museum. Against: one source, brief highway stop.

stronger_left_out.name: Ocean Shores
stronger_left_out.reason: Residential estate suburb; nothing a visitor does there beyond Brunswick Heads/New Brighton beach, which are separate.

stronger_left_out.name: Woodburn
stronger_left_out.reason: Small service town with no distinct visitor draw.

stronger_left_out.name: Cook Island
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: marine-reserve dive site, Wikivoyage and Wikipedia, 2 km offshore. Against: no landing, reachable only on dive/snorkel operators' trips; Julian Rocks is kept as the stronger, more accessible equivalent.

stronger_left_out.name: Mount Chincogan
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: Wikivoyage Mullumbimby lists the summit walk and it is the town's backdrop. Against: one source, short local hill walk.

stronger_left_out.name: Duranbah Beach
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source found; local surf beach.

stronger_left_out.name: Clarkes Beach
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: named by Wikivoyage with its own OSM beach. Against: one source and the sand is continuous with Main Beach; would be a near-duplicate.

stronger_left_out.name: Nimbin Rocks
stronger_left_out.reason: No counted source (Wikivoyage Nimbin does not list it); Aboriginal sacred site with no public access, viewed from the road.

stronger_left_out.name: Yamba Lighthouse
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: Wikivoyage lists the Clarence River Light on the headland with views. Against: small lighthouse, ten-minute look, one source.

stronger_left_out.name: Mallanganee National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: Case for: NPWS and Wikivoyage both list it, a World Heritage part with a lookout and camping. Against: Wikivoyage itself calls it not particularly famous, remote and rarely visited.

stronger_left_out.name: Mebbin National Park
stronger_left_out.reason: NPWS lists no public visitor facilities; nothing to do.

stronger_left_out.name: Cape Byron State Conservation Area
stronger_left_out.reason: Near-duplicate: the reserve is the land of the Cape Byron lighthouse walk already kept; one place.

stronger_left_out_note: The lowest kept score is 0 views (many kept beaches and a roadside icon have a Wikivoyage listing but no Wikipedia article), so every non-kept candidate with any views is technically stronger. Listed: every non-kept candidate with 500+ views or 2+ counted sources, each with its verdict and a concrete 'What qualifies' reason. The rest (under 500 views, one source) are in verdicts.json and skeptic.json. None was left out for want of a destination: Casino, Woodburn and Kyogle sit outside spans and were judged blind on their merits. Review cases (Kyogle, Mallanganee, Cook Island, New Italy, Nimbin Hemp Museum, Tweed Regional Museum, Koala Care Centre, Clarkes/Belongil/Shelly/Flat Rock/Lennox Point/Yamba Lighthouse/Ocean Pool/Turners Beach/Mount Chincogan) stay in the owner's review list, not placed.

benchmark.applicable: Northern Rivers has none of the NZ named benchmark places; analogues checked
